sorular.soru: In which rak'ah of salah is Subhanaka recited?
secenekler: B) Only in the first rak'ah
C) Only in the last rak'ah
D) In the first and last rak'ahs
sorular.aciklama: Subhanaka is recited only in the first rak'ah, immediately after the opening takbir. It is not recited in the other rak'ahs.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling on reciting Subhanaka?
sorular.aciklama: Reciting Subhanaka is Sunnah. Omitting it does not invalidate salah, but reciting it brings great reward.

sorular.soru: Which statement most accurately describes the ruling on reciting Surah al-Fatihah in salah?
secenekler: A) It is wajib in the Hanafi school and fard in the Shafi'i, Maliki, and Hanbali schools
B) It is only Sunnah in all schools
C) It is recited only in the final sitting
D) It is not recited in salah
sorular.aciklama: The ruling on reciting al-Fatihah differs between schools. It is considered wajib in the Hanafi school and fard in the Shafi'i, Maliki, and Hanbali schools. In practice, learners are taught to recite al-Fatihah in every rak'ah.

sorular.soru: In Hanafi practice, what is said after Surah al-Fatihah?
sorular.aciklama: Saying 'Amin' after al-Fatihah is Sunnah. In Hanafi practice, it is generally said silently; in some schools, it may be said aloud in prayers with audible recitation.

sorular.soru: What does 'Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim' mean?
secenekler: A) My Lord, the Most High, is free from imperfection
B) My Lord, the Magnificent, is free from all imperfection
C) O Allah, I declare You free from imperfection
sorular.aciklama: 'Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim' — My Lord, the Magnificent, is free from all imperfection. It is recited while bowing.

sorular.soru: What does 'Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la' mean?
secenekler: A) My Lord, the Magnificent, is free from all imperfection
B) My Lord, the Most High, is free from all imperfection
C) There is no god but Allah
sorular.aciklama: 'Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la' — My Lord, the Most High, is free from all imperfection. It is recited during prostration.

sorular.soru: What is the minimum number of times the remembrance for bowing is recited?
sorular.aciklama: Reciting 'Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim' at least once while bowing is sufficient. Reciting it 3 times is Sunnah.

sorular.soru: How many times is it Sunnah to recite the remembrance for prostration?
sorular.aciklama: It is Sunnah to recite 'Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la' 3 times during prostration. Reciting it at least once is sufficient.

sorular.soru: When is 'Rabbigfirli' recited?
secenekler: C) Between the two prostrations (jalsah — the brief sitting between two prostrations)
sorular.aciklama: 'Rabbigfirli' (My Lord, forgive me) is recited during the brief sitting between the two prostrations (jalsah — the brief sitting between two prostrations).

sorular.soru: What does 'Rabbigfirli' mean?
secenekler: A) O Allah, I declare You free from imperfection
B) All praise belongs to You
D) There is no god but Allah
sorular.aciklama: 'Rabbigfirli' — My Lord, forgive me. It is recited during the sitting between the two prostrations.

sorular.soru: In which sittings of salah is Tahiyyat recited?
secenekler: A) Only in the final sitting
C) Only in the first sitting
D) Only in prayers with 4 rak'ahs
sorular.aciklama: Tahiyyat (the supplication recited while sitting) is recited in every sitting of salah, both the first sitting and the final sitting.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling on reciting Tahiyyat?
sorular.aciklama: In Hanafi teaching, reciting Tahiyyat is taught as wajib. The final sitting itself is one of the pillars of salah.

sorular.soru: What is the first word of Tahiyyat?
sorular.aciklama: Tahiyyat begins with 'At-tahiyyatu lillahi...' It is recited in every sitting of salah.

sorular.soru: In which sitting of salah are the Salli and Barik supplications recited?
secenekler: B) Only in the first sitting
C) Only in the final sitting
sorular.aciklama: The Salli and Barik supplications are recited only in the final sitting (qa'dah al-akhirah), after Tahiyyat.

sorular.soru: What is the ruling on reciting the Salli and Barik supplications?
sorular.aciklama: Reciting Salli and Barik is Sunnah. They are recited in that order after Tahiyyat in the final sitting.

sorular.soru: What does 'Sami'allahu liman hamidah', said when rising from bowing, mean?
secenekler: A) I declare my Magnificent Lord free from imperfection
B) Allah hears the one who praises Him
C) Our Lord, all praise belongs to You
sorular.aciklama: 'Sami'allahu liman hamidah' — Allah hears the one who praises Him. It is said when rising from bowing.

sorular.soru: When is 'Rabbena ve lekel hamd' recited?
secenekler: A) When bending down to bow
C) Once fully upright in qawmah (the standing position after bowing)
sorular.aciklama: 'Semi'allahu' is said when rising from bowing, followed by 'Rabbena ve lekel hamd' once fully upright in qawmah.

sorular.soru: What does 'Rabbena ve lekel hamd' mean?
secenekler: B) Our Lord, all praise belongs to You
C) I declare You free from imperfection
sorular.aciklama: 'Rabbena ve lekel hamd' — 'Our Lord, all praise belongs to You.' It is said in qawmah (the standing position after bowing), once fully upright after bowing.

sorular.soru: In Hanafi practice, in which prayer is the Qunut supplication (the special supplication recited in Witr) recited?
sorular.aciklama: In Hanafi practice, the Qunut supplication (the special supplication recited in Witr) is recited in the third rak'ah of Witr prayer, before bowing. The Shafi'i school also has the practice of reciting Qunut in Fajr prayer.

sorular.soru: In Hanafi practice, in which rak'ah of Witr prayer is the Qunut supplication (the special supplication recited in Witr) recited?
sorular.aciklama: In Hanafi practice, the Qunut supplication (the special supplication recited in Witr) is recited in the third rak'ah of Witr prayer, after the additional surah (the surah recited after al-Fatihah) and before bowing.

sorular.soru: What does the phrase 'Subhanaka Allahumma' in Subhanaka mean?
secenekler: A) O Allah, I thank You
B) O Allah, I declare You free from imperfection
C) O Allah, I seek Your help
sorular.aciklama: 'Subhanakallahumma' — 'O Allah, I declare You free from all imperfection.' Subhanaka begins with this phrase.

sorular.soru: What can someone who does not yet know the Qunut supplications do?
secenekler: A) Recite a short supplication and continue learning Qunut
C) There is no need to learn anything
D) Repeat the Qunut takbir continuously
sorular.aciklama: Someone who does not yet know the Qunut supplications may recite a short supplication until they learn them; the aim is to continue memorizing the Qunut supplications.

sorular.soru: How many times are Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, and Allahu Akbar each said after salah?
sorular.aciklama: After the salam, Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah and Allahu Akbar are each recited 33 times.

sorular.soru: From which surah of the Qur'an is the 'Rabbena Atina' supplication taken?
sorular.aciklama: The supplication 'Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan...' is taken from verse 201 of Surah al-Baqarah.

sorular.soru: From which surah of the Qur'an is the 'Rabbanaghfir li' supplication taken?
sorular.aciklama: The supplication 'Rabbanaghfir li wa li walidayya...' is taken from verse 41 of Surah Ibrahim.

sorular.soru: In what order are the supplications recited after Tahiyyat in the final sitting?
sorular.aciklama: In the final sitting, Tahiyyat is followed by the supplications Salli, then Barik, then Rabbena, in that order.

sorular.soru: Which of the following is not included in the meaning of Subhanaka?
secenekler: A) Declaring Allah free from all imperfections
D) Declaring that there is no god but You
sorular.aciklama: Subhanaka includes declaring Allah free from all imperfections, praising Him and affirming that there is no other god. Asking for forgiveness is part of 'Rabbigfirli'.

sorular.soru: When is a servant closest to Allah?
sorular.aciklama: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'A servant is closest to Allah while prostrating.' (Muslim, Salah 215)

sorular.soru: Which of the following remembrances is recited after salah rather than during it?
sorular.aciklama: Alhamdulillah is recited 33 times after salah. The others are remembrances recited during salah.

sorular.soru: In Hanafi teaching, which of the following is emphasized as wajib (obligatory) in salah?
sorular.aciklama: In Hanafi teaching, reciting Tahiyyat is taught as wajib (obligatory). Subhanaka, Salli and Barik are Sunnah.
